explanation: Serre's uniformity question over ℚ (Serre 1972; Lemos arXiv:1702.01985, which proves the p > 37 surjectivity for non-CM curves with a rational cyclic isogeny): is there C such that for every elliptic E/ℚ without CM, the mod-p representation G_ℚ → Aut(E[p]) ≅ GL2(F_p) is surjective for all primes p > C? HasFullTorsionAction says every additive automorphism of the p-torsion of E(ℚ̄) (an F_p-vector space of rank 2) is induced by some σ ∈ Gal(ℚ̄/ℚ), which is surjectivity. Non-CM is encoded by j ∉ the 13 rational CM j-invariants (the list is the standard one: 0, 1728, −3375, 8000, −32768, 54000, 287496, −884736, −12288000, 16581375, −884736000, −147197952000, −262537412640768000), which is correct over ℚ. Faithful.
